mae_minutes.label: Mean absolute error
mae_minutes.definition: Average absolute difference between actual and predicted delivery duration.

rmse_minutes.label: Root mean squared error
rmse_minutes.definition: Square root of mean squared error; gives larger misses more influence.

over_15_minutes_rate.label: More than 15 minutes wrong
over_15_minutes_rate.definition: Share of ETA predictions with absolute error greater than 15 minutes.

deferred_rate.label: Human review rate
deferred_rate.direction: context dependent; must be reported with accuracy and coverage
deferred_rate.definition: Share of predictions withheld for dispatcher review by the configured risk rule.

coverage.label: Automatic output coverage
coverage.direction: higher is useful only when accuracy remains acceptable

n_test.label: Evaluation cases
n_test.definition: Number of complete delivery orders in the fixed evaluation set.
